column1: # Game profile of Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- The Prophecy of the Throne (Switch, base game 1.0.0 = v0, no update). On the Mac it plays from the title through its 2D story scenes and a 3D hallway scene (README.md); it needs the Vulkan layer's compute pipelines, argument buffers and DONT_CARE colour loads

# Own engine on The Forge renderer (application name ReZERO-TPT), SDK 9.5.0, on Vulkan: main imports only vkGetInstanceProcAddr from subsdk0 (the Vulkan loader, on NVIDIA's driver in subsdk1), and the host's Vulkan layer implements the rest on Metal (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m).

# The shaders are 41 SPIR-V files in fx/spirv (DXC-compiled HLSL), which dm/gfx/tools/vk_shaders.py translates; the NVN shader tables stay empty. subsdk2 is the movie module, which main imports from (the RomFS holds 3 WebM files)
# Started from the provisional profile of build_ipa_from_nsp.py: the keys below are its static guesses, kept unchanged because the game boots and plays on them; the note and what is open: README.md

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

column2: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- The Prophecy of the Throne

column1: # main imports Vulkan, not NVN: the host's Vulkan layer (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m); dm/gfx/tools/vk_shaders.py translates the SPIR-V shaders into <shader dir>/vk/
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk. Not loaded, replaced by the host's Vulkan layer or not needed by main: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan), subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL)
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so the game has no virtual address memory: main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB, a 3328 MB heap region

column2: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- The Prophecy of the Throne has no NVN shaders (its SPIR-V shaders go through the Vulkan layer)
